title: The Role of Transportation in the Persuasiveness of Public Narratives

publication.publisher_or_container: Journal of Personality and Social Psychology, vol. 79, no. 5, pp. 701-721

verification.verification_notes: Citation, volume, pages, and DOI confirmed via APA PsycNet abstract. Four experiments show transportation raises story-consistent beliefs and lowers detection of false notes; effects generally unaffected by fact/fiction labelling.
